exposure: Edinburgh postnatal depression scale (EPDS) scores at 3 days postpartum
cohort: 198 patients with single pregnancy at full term
finding: Labor analgesia was found to be a protective factor against PPD, while high family income and high EPDS scores at 3 days postpartum were associated with an increased risk of PPD.
mod_finding: Labor analgesia could reduce the incidence of PPD in women with single pregnancy at full term.
